title: Obsidian Graph Stats Orphan or Untagged Rate
dataSources: Obsidian graph stats (`obsidian:stats`), Roam daily notes (`roam:daily`), Logseq tasks (`logseq:task`), Zettelkasten notes (`zettel:note`), PKM review summaries (`pkm:review`).
app: Obsidian graph stats, Roam daily notes, Logseq task exports, and Zettelkasten counts streamed to Splunk HEC via plugins, CSV exports, and scripted vault scans.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=obsidian:stats
| stats avg(orphan_pct) as orphan_rate by vault
| sort - orphan_rate
description: Measures how much of obsidian graph stats is isolated, untagged, or otherwise hard to find later.
value: An orphan rate is a practical quality metric for second-brain systems because it captures future retrievability, not just raw volume.
implementation: Derive the orphan or untagged percentage during your vault export and store it alongside the summary event.
visualization: Table of vault values by orphan or untagged percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which parts of obsidian graph stats are hardest to reconnect to later.
